//: Type-checks client/test/*.test.ts against hand-written sidecar .d.ts files in client/js/.
client/js/*.js itself is intentionally NOT converted or type-checked here: it is served
straight to the browser via a bare <script type="module"> with no bundler in front of it
(see client/index.html), so turning it into real TypeScript would require adding a build
step this repo does not have. See the migration report for the full reasoning.
